label: late original-phase / delimiter steps, boosted when sequence starts with s/w/v/c
explanation: Fires only at the end of the input: original-phase steps with orig_idx >= 4 (mostly 6-8, i.e. the last 1-3 tokens of long L=7-9 sequences) and the <DEL> step; never in the copy phase and never at t < 4. Within that window it is strongly biased by the first original token (s, w, v, c give ~4x lift; j, e weaker) and by the current input token (h is the strongest and gives the top activations, ~0.97-1.0 of max; l, i, digits 1/2 moderate), and prefers first occurrences of the input token. The predicate (late input/delimiter step AND first token in {s,w,v,c}) captures about half the activation mass with low precision (~0.27); the remainder is a diffuse dependence on the token content of the prefix that no simple predicate captured. Window-only predicate (phase<=1 & t>=5) has ~100% recall but 5% precision.
